verdict.rationale: The docs state that the whole product runs on the user's own computer, using the user's own Claude Code or Codex. A GitHub repo with an install script, a `npm run doctor` setup check, and configurable env vars supports local self-hosting of the core app. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted install, an evidenced license, and fully local operation without the external Claude Code/Codex AI backends.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The whole thing runs on your own computer, with your own Claude Code or Codex.
The install script checks your setup and tells you if anything's missing. You can run the check again any time with `cd app && npm run doctor`.
